name: Beth the Exhibitionist
source:
Beth is staying at a hotel when she accidentally locks herself out of her room...naked. Your job is to help her make the right choices that'll lead her to clothes without getting arrested or being seen by too many people.

from[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584330/Beth_the_Exhibitionist/] Steam[/url]
translation:
贝丝住在一家酒店时，不小心把自己锁在房间外面……赤身裸体。你的工作是帮助她做出正确的选择，让她在不被捕或被太多人看到的情况下找到衣服。

来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584330/Beth_the_Exhibitionist/] Steam[/url]
